title: Microsoft Purview DLP: stop Copilot sending sensitive data to external web search
summary: Hold: the Cloud Policy control links to a page that does not document the final setting in its navigation path. The core web-search restriction and automation are supported, but some qualifications and a disagreement between Microsoft's feature article and general DLP reference should be carried through.

claims.quote: The Policy parameter specifies the existing DLP policy that contains the new DLP rule. For example, @(@{Name="U.S. Social Security Number (SSN)"; minCount="2"},@{Name="Credit Card Number"}). $true: Web grounding is blocked.
